geometryBasis: The seventeen mapped footprint corners define the projecting front, staggered low wings, and rear returns. Three exact same-day exteriors establish the brick window rhythm, pediment, porch, right gable and crenellated belvedere.
sectionBasis: Heights and roof sections are scaled estimates from the documented one- and two-storey façades. The independent original terrain is frozen before model authoring. The approximate foundation follows the slope down behind the house.
